caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cart with two large brown wheels attached to a rectangular wooden base, which appears to be reinforced with additional wooden planks. The cart features a cage-like structure on top, constructed from horizontal and vertical wooden rods that are secured together at the intersections, forming an open, square grid. The rods are light brown, and the overall wood color has varied shades of brown and beige, with slightly darker tones for the wheels. A long, sturdy handle extends from one end of the cart, with a rounded knob at the tip. The cart is set against a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or scenery. The name "TULITA WESTFALL" is written in small, red letters on the bottom left side of the drawing.
title: Wooden Cart
